title: Improve button loading skeleton and interactive cancellation flow
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refactor button loading behavior to introduce a lightweight skeleton state, add a user-cancel flow for long-running actions, and codify ARIA/announce rules across variants and icon-only buttons. This ticket addresses recent regressions where spinners blocked interactions and caused confusing focus behavior on keyboard users and screen readers.
acceptance_criteria: Primary and secondary button variants show a token-driven skeleton (height/width/padding) when action is pending for >120ms; no layout shift for in-flow buttons.
Icon-only buttons transition to a compact spinner overlay without enlarging hit target or moving surrounding content.
Long-running requests (>3s by default) surface an inline cancel affordance that is keyboard and screen-reader accessible and calls a cancellable API surface (frontend + backend hooks documented).
Spinner and skeleton states respect reduced-motion token and theme variables (light/dark/high-contrast).

Screen readers receive a single polite announcement when a button enters loading and a confirmation announcement when the action completes or is cancelled; duplicate announcements are avoided for batched updates.
Design docs and Figma prototypes exist for primary, secondary, and ghost variants, plus icon-only states across three sizes (sm/md/lg).
Unit and visual regression tests added; manual QA checklist completed across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, macOS VoiceOver, NVDA, and TalkBack.
design_notes: Introduce a token group button.loading.* to control skeleton color, shimmer presence, spinner size and delay thresholds. This keeps runtime toggles configurable per product without hardcoding values.
Prefer a lightweight skeleton (background color + subtle inset) over full overlay whenever the button sits inside a row/list to avoid occluding secondary content and to reduce perceived jank.

For icon-only buttons, use a circular spinner pseudo-element positioned with transform so it does not affect layout or hit target; apply aria-hidden on decorative spinners and expose status via aria-live region instead.
Cancellation flow: show an inline text button ("Cancel") to the right of the loading button after 3s; on small layouts collapse into a tooltip-accessible cancel action to avoid layout overflow.
Trade-offs: adding cancel affordance increases visual complexity; to mitigate, keep default delay conservative (3s) and allow per-route overrides via token or props.
